activity.notes: Circling Raven appears in Coeur d'Alene (Schitsu'umsh) oral history as an earlier head chief and visionary. A local Kootenai County historical account retrospectively dates the vision about later 'Black Robes' to 1740; a University of Idaho Schitsu'umsh cultural history instead describes him as head chief 'during the 1600s'. The circa-1740 datum is therefore contested oral-tradition chronology only, NOT an established birth, death, accession, regnal span, or independently dated prophetic event. Retain this year as an uncertain representative point and keep indigenous cultural sources explicit; never assert he personally met 1842 missionaries.
